build_task_template: build a phyre task template that creates a fulcrum beam and ball scene with configurable parameters
create_static_bar: create a static bar obstacle in the phyre scene at a specified height and angle
add_dynamic_ball: add a dynamic ball to the phyre scene positioned on top of a beam
define_spatial_relationship: define a touching spatial relationship between a ball and target in the phyre task
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to TWO_BALLS for the phyre task
